search.label: Search area
search.placeholder: City, area, or street with number
search.notFound: We could not locate that area. Try a city, or a street with a number.
search.failed: Area lookup did not respond. Please try again shortly.

coverage.heading: What we cover today
coverage.error: We could not measure coverage — so we declare none.
coverage.noSupply: There are no listings yet. We will not ask you to search for something that does not exist.
coverage.noLocation: {total, plural, one {# listing} other {# listings}} — none with a declared location yet. That is why we do not ask you «where»: the filter would have nothing to work on.
coverage.partial: {total, plural, one {# listing} other {# listings}} · {mapped} with a declared location · {unmapped} without. Area search filters only the former — the rest always appear.

ledger.summary: {total} properties · {mapped} on the map · {unmapped} with no declared location
ledger.empty: No listings yet — and the map says so, instead of looking empty without explanation.
ledger.imbalanced: The count does not balance — this is a defect, not a state.

unmapped.heading: {count, plural, one {# more — it may be here, it may not} other {# more — they may be here, they may not}}
unmapped.hint: These are not filtered out when you move the map: we cannot exclude them from an area we do not know they belong to.

reason.neverAsked: The location has not been recorded yet
reason.ownerDeclined: The owner has not declared a location

absent.title: This listing is no longer published
absent.body: The link is not wrong — the property has been withdrawn from the public list. That does not mean it does not exist; it means we are not publishing it right now.

error.title: The listing could not be loaded
error.body: This is not the same as «does not exist»: something did not respond. Please try again shortly.

media.absent: There is no image for this property yet. We do not put someone else's photo in its place: it would show a different property and be read as this one.

position.heading: Where it is
position.unknown: We have no location for this property — which is why there is no map here.

meaning.outline: We hold the actual outline. What you see is surveyed, not inferred.
meaning.pin: Exact address — the pin points at the building.
meaning.pinWithRing: We know the street, not the number. The property is somewhere along it.
meaning.shadedCircle: We know the area, not the address. The shaded zone is not the property.
meaning.shadedCity: We only know the city. We shade the city instead of dropping a pin, because a pin here would be an address we do not have.

open.heading: What we do not publish yet
open.intro: We say it instead of staying silent: silence on these reads as «it has none», which would be false.
open.legality: Legality and its provenance. It does not exist in the system yet, and we do not guess it: an engineer's certificate is mandatory at transfer, so a guess here would become a problem at the notary.
open.floorplan: Floor plan. There is no field for it in the public projection — it is not empty, it is missing.
open.dossier: Document dossier. The documents exist, but publishing them is a separate decision that has not been taken.
